explanation: It fires only at D1 (strongly, 8-10), when the trial just before ended in S2 and was rewarded, and the agent had mostly been in S1 or unrewarded before that: a rare a1-to-S2 reward, or the first rewarded S2 visit after a run of S1 or no reward; this mostly happens around trials 65-85, earlier in the episode it reaches only about 2 and after trial 90 it stays near 0. It is 0 at every GO and D2 step, at D1 after an unrewarded trial or an S1 reward, and at the second and later rewarded S2 visits in a row.
